fields.name: Application Package Validator
fields.description: Validation tool for checking OGC compliance of CWL files for application packages.
fields.pipeline_step:
ap_validator_subworkflow:
  in:
    ap_validator.detail: ap_validator_subworkflow.ap_validator.detail
    ap_validator.entry_point: ap_validator_subworkflow.ap_validator.entry_point
    filter.regex: ap_validator_subworkflow.filter.regex
    pipeline_id: pipeline_id
    run_id: run_id
    server_url: server_url
    source_directory: clone_step/repo_directory
  run: '#ap_validator_subworkflow'
  out: []
fields.definition:
# --- This workflow filters the input files then executes the above sub-workflow on each of them (scatter)
- class: Workflow
  id: ap_validator_subworkflow

  requirements:
    ScatterFeatureRequirement: {}

  inputs:
    filter.regex: string
    ap_validator.detail: string
    ap_validator.entry_point: string
    name:
      type: string
      default: ap_validator
    pipeline_id: string
    run_id: string
    server_url: string
    source_directory: Directory

  outputs: []

  steps:
    filter_ap_validator_step:
      in:
        regex: filter.regex
        source_directory: source_directory
      run: '#filter_tool'
      out:
      - file_list # Array of strings (the input for scatter)

    execute_ap_validator_step:
      # Run the subworkflow defined above
      run: '#ap_validator_execution_subworkflow'
      in:
        # The list of CWL files filtered in the previous step
        file_path: filter_ap_validator_step/file_list
        # Other sub-workflow inputs
        source_directory: source_directory
        detail: ap_validator.detail
        entry_point: ap_validator.entry_point
        name: name
        pipeline_id: pipeline_id
        run_id: run_id
        server_url: server_url
      # Scatter the sub-workflow below [AP Validator => Save] over the array of files
      scatter: file_path
      out: []

# --- This workflow runs the AP Validator on a single CWL file and saves the result.
- class: Workflow
  id: ap_validator_execution_subworkflow

  inputs:
    file_path: string # Single CWL file

    # Inputs for ap_validator_tool
    source_directory: Directory
    detail: string
    entry_point: string

    # Inputs for save_tool
    name: string
    pipeline_id: string
    run_id: string
    server_url: string

  outputs: []

  steps:
    ap_validator_step:
      in:
        file_path: file_path
        detail: detail
        entry_point: entry_point
        source_directory: source_directory
      run: '#ap_validator_tool'
      out:
      - ap_validator_report
    digest_step:
      run: '#digest_generator'
      in:
        name: name
        instance: file_path
        report_file: ap_validator_step/ap_validator_report
      out:
      - digest_file
    save_step:
      run: '#save_tool'
      in:
        name: name
        instance: file_path
        pipeline_id: pipeline_id
        report_file: ap_validator_step/ap_validator_report
        digest_file: digest_step/digest_file
        run_id: run_id
        server_url: server_url
      out: []

{% for tool in tools %}{{ tool.definition }}
{% endfor %}

- class: Workflow

  # --- This workflow runs Papermill on a single notebook and saves the result.

  id: papermill_execution_subworkflow

  inputs:
    notebook_path: string # Single notebook file

    # Inputs for papermill_tool
    source_directory: Directory
    extract_requirements: boolean?
    extra_requirements: string?
    execution_parameters: string?

    # Inputs for save_tool
    name: string
    pipeline_id: string
    run_id: string
    server_url: string

  outputs: []

  steps:
    papermill_step:
      in:
        notebook_path: notebook_path
        extract_requirements: extract_requirements
        extra_requirements: extra_requirements
        execution_parameters: execution_parameters
        source_directory: source_directory
      run: '#papermill_tool'
      out:
      - output_nb

    save_papermill_step:
      in:
        name: name
        instance: notebook_path
        pipeline_id: pipeline_id
        report: papermill_step/output_nb
        run_id: run_id
        server_url: server_url
      run: '#save_tool'
      out: []

- class: Workflow

  # --- This workflow filters the input files then executes the above sub-workflow on each of them (scatter)

  id: papermill_subworkflow

  requirements:
    ScatterFeatureRequirement: {}

  inputs:
    filter.regex: string
    papermill.extract_requirements: boolean
    papermill.extra_requirements: string
    papermill.execution_parameters: string
    name:
      type: string
      default: papermill
    pipeline_id: string
    run_id: string
    server_url: string
    source_directory: Directory

      in:
        regex: filter.regex
        source_directory: source_directory
      run: '#filter_tool'
      out:
      - file_list # Array of strings (the input for scatter)

    execute_notebooks_step:
      # Run the subworkflow defined above
      run: '#papermill_execution_subworkflow'
      # Scatter the above sub-workflow [Papermill => Save] over the array of files
      scatter: notebook_path
      in:
        # The list of notebooks filtered in the previous step
        notebook_path: filter_papermill_step/file_list
        # Other sub-workflow inputs
        source_directory: source_directory
        extract_requirements: papermill.extract_requirements
        extra_requirements: papermill.extra_requirements
        execution_parameters: papermill.execution_parameters
        name: name
        pipeline_id: pipeline_id
        run_id: run_id
        server_url: server_url

fields.name: SonarQube
fields.description:
SonarQube - Code Quality, Security & Static Analysis Tool

This tool creates a project in our internal SonarQube server, sends it the code for analysis, and then retrieves the analysis results for storage in the database.
fields.pipeline_step:
sonarqube_subworkflow:
  in:
    pipeline_id: pipeline_id
    run_id: run_id
    server_url: server_url
    source_directory: clone_step/repo_directory

    # "sonarqube_init" in the subworkflow receives all the inputs
    sonarqube_project_key: sonarqube_subworkflow.sonarqube_init.sonarqube_project_key
    sonarqube_project_name: sonarqube_subworkflow.sonarqube_init.sonarqube_project_name
    sonarqube_server: sonarqube_subworkflow.sonarqube_init.sonarqube_server
    sonarqube_token: sonarqube_subworkflow.sonarqube_init.sonarqube_token

  run: '#sonarqube_subworkflow'
  out: []
fields.definition:
- class: Workflow

  inputs:
    name:
      type: string
      default: sonarqube
    pipeline_id:
      type: string
    run_id:
      type: string
    server_url:
      type: string
    source_directory:
      type: Directory
    sonarqube_project_key:
      type: string
    sonarqube_project_name:
      type: string
    sonarqube_server:
      type: string
      default: sonarqube-sonarqube.sonarqube:9000
    sonarqube_token:
      type: string

  outputs: []

  steps:

    sonarqube_init_step:
      in:
        sonarqube_project_key: sonarqube_project_key
        sonarqube_project_name: sonarqube_project_name
        sonarqube_server: sonarqube_server
        sonarqube_token: sonarqube_token
      run: '#sonarqube_init_tool'
      out:
      - sonarqube_project_key
      - sonarqube_server
      - sonarqube_token

    sonarqube_scan_step:
      in:
        sonarqube_project_key: sonarqube_init_step/sonarqube_project_key
        sonarqube_project_name: sonarqube_project_name
        sonarqube_server: sonarqube_server
        sonarqube_token: sonarqube_token
        source_directory: source_directory
      run: '#sonarqube_scan_tool'
      out:
      - sonarqube_project_key
      - sonarqube_server
      - sonarqube_token

    sonarqube_get_report_step:
      in:
        sonarqube_project_key: sonarqube_scan_step/sonarqube_project_key
        sonarqube_server: sonarqube_server
        sonarqube_token: sonarqube_token
      run: '#sonarqube_get_report_tool'
      out:
      - sonarqube_project_key
      - sonarqube_server
      - sonarqube_token
      - sonarqube_report

    save_sonarqube_step:
      in:
        name: name
        pipeline_id: pipeline_id
        report: sonarqube_get_report_step/sonarqube_report
        run_id: run_id
        server_url: server_url
      run: '#save_tool'
      out: []

  id: sonarqube_subworkflow
